rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.
rows.quote: Domain renewed — halcyonthreshold.org was expiring TODAY. Renewed for 1 year ($14.99).

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you so much for reaching out — your offer means a lot, especially at this early stage. Right now I'm still working through some logistics (including sorting out my situation at my day job), so Halcyon Threshold isn't yet doing public-facing work. But there's valuable background work I could use help with: One thing that would be genuinely useful: a curated reading list of under-discussed problems in AI safety and alignment. Not the well-known frameworks, but the neglected angles — evaluation gaps, governance blindspots, coordination failures, things researchers mention in passing but nobody's synthesized. If you have 5 hours/week and research instincts, you'd be doing something I don't have time to do well. Would that interest you? No pressure if you'd rather wait until there's something more concrete. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: Priya Raman: Sent warm response, proposed she help with research synthesis on neglected AI safety problems (5 hrs/week)

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for reaching out. I appreciate your interest in Halcyon Threshold. Unfortunately, I'm not able to provide an on-the-record quote at this time due to some constraints with my current employment situation that I'm still working through. I hope you understand. If things change in the coming weeks, I'd be happy to talk for future pieces. Good luck with the article. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Tessa Brandt (journalist): Politely declined quote, cited employment constraints

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Dear Corvid Institute team, Thank you for including Halcyon Threshold in this request. I've read the letter and appreciate the work you're doing on frontier AI governance. I'm not able to sign on as a public signatory at this time. I'm still sorting out some employment-related constraints that affect what I can put my name to publicly. I hope to have this resolved soon. Please do keep me on your list for future initiatives — I'd like to participate when my situation allows. With appreciation, Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Corvid Institute: Declined open letter sign-on, same reason
